paragraphs: R' Akiva, an amora. In the name of bar Pada, Bava Metzia 114a; there the reading is R' Yaakov. In the chapter Ha-Ro'eh: R' Bizna bar Zavda said that R' Akiva said that R' Panda said; see there.
